claims.statement: Aiming for mid-single-digit value growth for the full year.
claims.quote: We are looking at mid-single-digit value growth for the full year.

claims.statement: Anticipating the gap between volume and value to remain in the zone of about 4-5%.
claims.quote: we would anticipate that the gap between the volume and the value would remain in that zone of about 4-5%.

claims.statement: Maintaining the PBDIT margin guidance band of 18 to 20%.
claims.quote: It's good to maintain 18-20% margin as we go ahead.

facts.statement: Standalone net sales grew by 6.4%, supported by decorative, industrial and international business.
facts.quote: net sales grew by 6.4%, supported by growth across decorative, industrial and international business.

facts.statement: Gross margins at 43.1% were higher by 250 bps.
facts.quote: Gross margins at 43.1% was higher by 250 bps.

facts.statement: PBDIT margin of 17.7% was higher by 220 bps points.
facts.quote: PBDIT margin of 17.7% was higher by 220 bps points.

facts.statement: The company declared an interim dividend of Rs. 4.5.
facts.quote: We have declared interim dividend of Rs. 4.5.

facts.statement: Standalone PBDIT margin in Q2 is at 18.5% and consolidated level is closer to 18%.
facts.quote: at the standalone level, in Q2 we are at 18.5% at standalone level and at consolidated level, we are closer to 18%.
